2608.07091.title: Human-Centered Explainable AI for TinyML Edge Devices: A Pareto-Based Selection Framework with LLM-Guided Design
2608.07091.paper_summary: Edge Artificial Intelligence (Edge AI) enables the deployment of AI models directly on local edge devices, while such deployments are subject to strict resource constraints, particularly in clinical applications requiring local and timely inference. In such contexts, explainable artificial intelligence (XAI) can serve as a human-AI interface intended to support healthcare professionals' and patients' understanding of model predictions and informed decision-making. To fulfill this role, XAI method selection for TinyML deployments can be formulated as a human-centered multi-objective design problem that jointly considers qualitative stakeholder preferences, explanation quality, and proxy-based deployment cost. We propose a framework that integrates a large language model (LLM)-guided design interface that maps qualitative stakeholder preferences to candidate XAI methods, followed by deterministic feasibility filtering and Pareto-based optimization. The framework exposes trade-offs among explanation fidelity, stability, and proxy-based deployment cost while characterizing their implications for explanation quality and estimated deployment feasibility. A proof-of-concept evaluation on a skin lesion classification task illustrates how the framework systematically compares candidate XAI methods and identifies Pareto-efficient trade-offs. The present evaluation covers the computational selection stages, while physical MCU deployment and empirical human-expert validation remain outside the scope of this study.
2608.07091.paper_summary_zh: 邊緣人工智慧（Edge AI）使得可以直接在本地邊緣設備上部署人工智慧模型，而這些部署受到嚴格的資源限制，特別是在需要本地和及時推斷的臨床應用中。在這樣的情境下，可解釋的人工智慧（XAI）可以作為人類與人工智慧之間的介面，旨在支持醫療專業人員和患者對模型預測的理解及知情決策。為了實現這一角色，TinyML 部署的 XAI 方法選擇可以被表述為一個以人為中心的多目標設計問題，該問題共同考慮質性利益相關者偏好、解釋質量和基於代理的部署成本。我們提出了一個框架，該框架整合了一個大型語言模型（LLM）引導的設計介面，將質性利益相關者偏好映射到候選的 XAI 方法，然後進行確定性可行性篩選和基於帕累托的優化。該框架揭示了解釋真實性、穩定性和基於代理的部署成本之間的權衡，同時描述了它們對解釋質量和預估部署可行性的影響。對皮膚病變分類任務的概念驗證評估展示了該框架如何系統地比較候選的 XAI 方法並識別帕累托有效的權衡。本次評估涵蓋了計算選擇階段，而物理 MCU 部署和經驗性人類專家驗證則超出了本研究的範疇。
